purpose: Reconcile canonical Session semantics with Payload 3.87.1 native persistence by storing only the five proven unsupported dimensions in a minimal extension record keyed by the native session id.

extensionPersistence.purpose: Store only canonical dimensions absent from Payload native UserSession.

authorityRules: The native Payload session id is the only Session identity; the extension row MUST NOT mint another session identifier.
Native session existence and expiry are mandatory prerequisites for authorization.
Canonical revocation, tokenVersion and device binding are additional mandatory authorization predicates.
If either native session state or extension state is unavailable, authorization MUST fail closed.
The extension record is not a replacement or mirror of users.sessions[]; it stores only unsupported canonical dimensions.
No alternate cache may become an authorization authority.

lifecycle.login: Payload creates native sid; integration creates exactly one extension row for that sid.
lifecycle.logout: Payload removes native session; extension revocation is durably recorded before success is reported when canonical audit requires it.
lifecycle.refresh: Native sid remains stable; refresh credential verifier is atomically advanced and predecessor replay is rejected.
lifecycle.expiry: Native expiresAt is authoritative and extension checks may only add restrictions.
lifecycle.accountInvalidation: Increment/invalidate tokenVersion according to the canonical account-state contract; stale sessions must fail validation.
lifecycle.activity: last_seen_at may be updated with bounded frequency and must never be the sole authorization predicate.

migrationRules.rollback: No destructive rollback of live session state; use compensating migration where necessary.

foreignKeyPolicy.userId: Physical FK only after ENT-USER schema authority is proven; otherwise logical reference with application integrity checks.
foreignKeyPolicy.sessionId: References native users.sessions[].id logically; no physical FK is required because native session is embedded data, not a relational table row.

runtimeRules: authLogin MUST NOT report success unless native sid and extension state are both durably established when extension state is required.
session validation MUST verify native sid, native expiry, user binding, device binding, tokenVersion and revokedAt.
refresh MUST use compare-and-update or transactional equivalent on the extension record.
concurrent refresh for the same predecessor credential MUST allow at most one success.
logout MUST be idempotent and MUST NOT silently lose canonical revocation state.
refreshCredentialHash MUST never be returned, logged or included in events/DTOs.
verificationMatrix: native sid to extension row one-to-one proof
